title.narrative: UNICEF invested in analysis on communication, advocacy, digital audience, paid media, and influencer engagement. The outreach included 37 press releases on key advocacy priorties of climate action, children in Bangsamoro and emergencies, resulting in 9,000 media mentions. Social media followers increased by 62 per cent to 1,795,772, web users by 50 per cent to 1,285,000.
